proposed_comments.title: Restore the protected MoreCommands accessor used by derived helpers
proposed_comments.body:
### Restore the protected MoreCommands accessor used by derived helpers

**Severity:** `high`

The current head does not build: `CleanupFailureListItemViewModel` in `ListItemInitializationCoordinatorTests` still derives from `ListItemViewModel` and adds a cleanup item through the protected `UnsafeMoreCommands` accessor, but this PR removed that member. Keeping it as an alias of the refactored context-item storage preserves the derived helper contract and fixes the exact CmdPal test-project build.

```suggestion
    protected List<IContextItemViewModel> UnsafeContextItems => _contextItems;

    protected List<IContextItemViewModel> UnsafeMoreCommands => _contextItems;
```
